create.name: Ocean Gate Zen Center
create.bio:
Ocean Gate is a small community temple in the Soto Zen tradition, set on 41st Avenue at the edge of Capitola and serving Santa Cruz's South Side, Soquel, Aptos and the surrounding county. Founded in 2007 as a non-profit religious organisation, it is led by two guiding teachers, Rev. Daijaku (Jaku) Kinst and Rev. Shinshu Roberts, who hold their lineage through Sojun Mel Weitsman and, before him, Shunryu Suzuki. The temple describes its practice as warm and questioning, with every enquiry welcomed and everyone invited through the door.

Zazen is the heart of the week: early sittings on Tuesday and Thursday, a mid-morning sit and service on Friday and an evening period on Thursday, all open in person or on Zoom. On Saturdays the "Come As You Are" morning pairs a short sit with tea and a talk by one of the teachers or a senior student, followed by questions, and on the first Saturday of each month newcomers can arrive early for sitting instruction. Half-day and full-day sittings, study groups and ceremonies deepen the practice, and every Dharma programme is offered free, supported by donations. Recorded talks appear on the centre's YouTube channel and podcast.

courses.title: Saturday Morning Come As You Are
courses.description: The weekly Saturday programme: twenty minutes of zazen, an informal tea, then a Dharma talk by one of the guiding teachers or a senior practitioner with time for questions. Suitable for beginners, who can come half an hour early on the first Saturday of the month for sitting instruction.

courses.title: Regular Weekly Schedule
courses.description: Group zazen in the zendo on Tuesday and Thursday mornings with a chanting service, Friday mid-morning, and Thursday evening followed by a short service and a chance to ask questions about practice. Sittings can also be joined on Zoom.

courses.title: Extended Schedule: Half-Day and Full-Day Sittings
courses.description: Regular extended sittings that alternate periods of zazen with walking meditation, plus study classes and practice intensives led by the centre's teachers. Half-day sits include a public talk; full-day sits run into the afternoon with an informal oryoki lunch. Beginners are welcome.

free_resources.title: Ocean Gate Zen Center Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: Recordings of the Saturday morning talks on Soto Zen teaching and practice, available as videos and as an audio podcast.

free_resources.title: How to Sit Zazen
free_resources.description: A short guide to starting a sitting practice, with an introductory video, advice on choosing a posture on a cushion, bench or chair, and encouragement for meeting a busy mind with patience.
